propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple lifecycle concerns (identity transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, unretire) that should be extracted into a private policy owner
Production rich-text convergence mutates inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings(), bypassing future policy control and needs a narrow supported mutation seam
Lifecycle operations must preserve at-most-one identity and remove stale reverse entries only in existing permitted cases via targeted single-key pops, not sweeping searches
Numeric-ID lookup re-keys instead of retiring, three confirmed 404s retire after reset, and legacy entries without comment-ID field remain readable without forced rewrite
A narrow rich-emission operation (note_rich_emit) must match current hash/counter/save behavior while keeping missing bindings fail-open, without changing all_bindings() copy depth

Facade signatures and backward compatibility must be preserved; no caller receives direct writable repository access and no schema, corruption disposition, or stored identity-marker changes occur in this slice
